senses.gloss:
√1vidh (vidháti). worship a god (dat.)
with (instr.); honor (acc.) with (instr.).
[cf. vedhas.]

√2vidh (vindháte). lack or be without a
thing (instr.), viduāri; be bereft or alone.
[see vidhavā.]

vídh, vbl. boring through, wounding, at
end of cpds. [√3 vidh or vyadh, 252, cf.
785.]

vidhávā, f. widow. [√2vidh, ‘be bereft,’
1190; cf. ἠ-ίθεος, ‘youth without a wife.
[]
bachelor’; Lat. viduus, vidua, ‘widower,
widow’; AS. widwe, wuduwe, Eng. widow.]

vidhā́, f. proportion, measure; way; and
so kind, sort; esp. at end of cpds [see
1302c 5]: e. g. tri-vidha, of three kinds,
three-fold. [prop. ‘dis-position, arrangement,
 order, method,’ see √1dhā + vi.]

vidhātavya, grdv. to be shown. [√1dhā
+ vi, mg 5.]

vidhi, m.
 —1. a dis-position, ordinance,
prescription, rule (65^7), method;
 —2.
(method, i. e.) way, 38^23; procedure;
 —3.
(the supreme disposition or ordaining, i. e.)
destiny, fate. [√1dhā + vi, 1155. 2e,
345^2: for mg 3, cf. Lat. destināre, ‘establish,
 ordain,’ and Eng. destiny.]

vidhivat, adv. according to rule; equiv.
to Lat. rite. [vidhi, 1107.]

vidheya, grdv. to be done. [see √1dhā
+ vi, mg 5: also 963^3a.]
